title: alchemilla orizabensis
intro: Alchemilla orizabensis, commonly known as the Oaxacan lady's mantle, is a plant species native to Mexico. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, calming digestive issues, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla orizabensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
